attributes.background: This petition seeks to remove the audible part of ALL fireworks due to the psychological harm and distress on domestic and wild animals.  Domestic and wild animals should not have to endure stress from explosion sounds.  Fireworks can still be attractive visually without the need of a loud sound.

rejection.details:
We have a that has opened very recently which calls for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign it.

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
